description: Figure 6 illustrates the average number of tokens generated under varying numbers of shots with few-shot style prompting. The horizontal axis represents the number of shots, labeled “Number of Shots,” with categories ranging from 0 to 8 in a linear scale. The vertical axis represents the average number of tokens, labeled “Average Number of Tokens,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Three colored lines are displayed, each representing a different prompting style: zero-shot (solid blue line), one-shot (dashed orange line), and eight-shot (dotted green line). The zero-shot line begins at approximately 85 tokens with 0 shots, decreasing to around 60 tokens with 8 shots. The one-shot line starts at approximately 65 tokens with 0 shots, decreasing to around 45 tokens with 8 shots. The eight-shot line begins at approximately 40 tokens with 0 shots, decreasing to around 30 tokens with 8 shots. All three lines demonstrate a general decreasing trend in the average number of tokens as the number of shots increases. The lines are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars or data points are visually emphasized.
